snippet.title: Steam 「Ninja Issen (忍者一閃)」 Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
"There is no past or present in the place you shall find yourself in, Kiba!"

「Ninja Issen (忍者一閃)」 is a retro-style ninja platformer that features a variety of hyper action, 1 vs. many battles, and dynamic boss fights. It is full of ninjas, robots, neon lights, and dark atmosphere that overwhelms the streets of the future metropolis.

You will be 「Kiba」, a rogue ninja who was falsely accused of assassinating the grand master of his clan. In his desperate fight to escape from other ninjas trying to avenge his crime, 「Kiba」 suddenly finds himself in the middle of the world he has never seen.

Will Kiba be able to uncover the secrets of his past, and get his revenge?

Brace yourself for hyper ninja action and maneuvers that will make your heart pound!
*Available November 23, 2023 on Steam

● 「Ninja Issen (忍者一閃)」 Steam store page
